endpoints.summary: Check a user in with a booking code; the booking becomes in progress
endpoints.description: Requires the X-Agent-Id, X-Agent-Timestamp, X-Agent-Nonce and X-Agent-Signature headers (see the agentSignatureAuth security scheme). Call when the user enters a booking code at login. Eligible only for an approved booking on this computer's bench, from its start until 10 minutes later (reserved) or until it ends (in progress). Repeating a check-in is safe. Every failure returns checked_in: false with no other fields.

endpoints.summary: End a booking at the user's request; the booking becomes completed
endpoints.description: Requires the X-Agent-Id, X-Agent-Timestamp, X-Agent-Nonce and X-Agent-Signature headers (see the agentSignatureAuth security scheme). Call only when the user chooses to end the booking, not at every logout. Only an approved, in-progress booking on this computer's bench can be ended; repeating the call is safe. The booked end time is not changed. Every failure returns completed: false with no other fields.

completed.description: True when the booking is now completed.

ends_at.description: The booked end time, unchanged; present only when completed.

400.description: Body is not a JSON object

endpoints.summary: Extend a running booking at the user's request
endpoints.description: Requires the X-Agent-Id, X-Agent-Timestamp, X-Agent-Nonce and X-Agent-Signature headers (see the agentSignatureAuth security scheme). Only an approved, in-progress booking on this computer's bench can be extended: at least 10 minutes later than the current end, before the current end has passed, without overlapping the next booking, and at most 4 hours from the start (longer bookings need approval in the web app). Seconds are dropped. Repeating the same end time is safe. An unknown or foreign booking returns extended: false with no other fields.

ends_at.description: The new end time. Seconds are dropped.

extended.description: True when the booking now ends at ends_at.

ends_at.description: The new end; present only when extended.
